verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
My sins You forgive
You say "Go in peace"
My fears You take away
You say "Be not afraid"

verse.name: p1
verse.lines:
You put a new song in my mouth
A song of praise to my God
So I sing, so I sing

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Father You are my Life Rebuilder
Jesus the God who saves
Your Spirit awakens me from slumber
I now arise and shine for You

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
What is broken You rebuild
What is shamed You restore
What is in chains You set free
You say "I make all things new"
